init_franka_robot: create a FrankaRobot instance with a URDF path and Habitat simulator for 7-DOF arm control
get_franka_params: call _get_franka_params to retrieve StaticManipulatorParams with default arm joint, gripper, and motor configuration
configure_arm_joints: customize FrankaRobot arm joints by overriding _get_franka_params to change the 7 joint indices
set_gripper_state: configure gripper open and closed states via StaticManipulatorParams gripper_open_state and gripper_closed_state arrays
tune_motor_gains: adjust arm motor position gain, velocity gain, and max impulse through _get_franka_params parameters
